name: W Aspen
positioning: A design-led ski resort at the base of Aspen Mountain with ski-in/ski-out access and a year-round rooftop with a heated pool and 360-degree mountain views
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access to Aspen Mountain in the heart of town
Groups of friends who want bunk-bed rooms and a lively rooftop scene

facts.text: The hotel sits at the base of Aspen Mountain, near Aspen Snowmass.
The hotel is in the heart of town, just steps from Aspen Mountain.
The hotel is a modern take on a Swiss mountain chalet, with furniture inspired by the '70s Aspen "pleasure palaces."
All rooms feature pit and platform lounge seating with Ute-inspired accent pillows.
The Studio Suite pays homage to the Ute Native Americans who originally inhabited the valley through its prints and patterns.
The Rooftop has a DJ playing ambient beats by the heated pool.
Hidalgo is a speakeasy-style bar with live DJ sets on Friday and Saturday nights.
Guests can take BMW X7 and X5 test drives around town for up to two hours.
The Sky Residences at W Aspen offer two- and three-bedroom residences with full kitchens and a private rooftop lounge with panoramic views.

highlights.text: The rooftop has a heated pool, hot tub, fire pits, food and drink service and 360-degree views of the Colorado Rocky Mountains.
Aspen Mountain provides ski-in/ski-out access from the resort.
The design is inspired by generations of Aspen inhabitants and visitors, from the Ute Native Americans and silver miners to the counterculture of the '60s and '70s.
Select rooms and suites have quad-queen bunk beds that can accommodate up to eight people.
The Presidential Suite draws on Aspen's history from Silver Rush mining hub to ski town, with a color palette reminiscent of the '60s and '70s.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
WhataHotel notes the lively party atmosphere may not suit all travelers.
WhataHotel notes pricing is premium, typical of luxury Aspen properties.
